source_refs.note: iii) Selective catalytic reduction (SCR): a main subheading of 14.14 Strategies used to reduce air pollution, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 318-318.

blocks.text: SCR diesel engines mein exhaust gases se pollutants hatane ke liye istemal hota hai. Yeh TiO₂ aur zeolites jaise catalysts ki madad se, urea se bani ammonia (NH₃) ke zariye, NOₓ ko reduce kar ke N₂ aur H₂O banata hai. CO aur hydrocarbons ko alag oxidation catalyst oxidise karta hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke SCR CO aur hydrocarbons ko bhi oxidise karta hai. SCR sirf NOₓ ko reduce karta hai: exhaust mein urea ka solution dala jata hai jo ammonia deta hai, aur ammonia catalyst par NOₓ ko N₂ aur H₂O mein badal deti hai. CO aur hydrocarbons ka oxidation alag oxidation catalyst karta hai.

blocks.alt: Exhaust saaf karne ki line. Engine se teer NOx, CO, HC aur PM ko Oxidation Catalyst mein le jata hai, phir patli nali jahan neeli urea line Urea Dosing System (sabz cone) par andar aati hai, phir chauda dabba jis mein Urea SCR block aur NH3 Oxidate Catalyst block hain. Teer N2, CO2, H2O aur PM ke saath bahar nikalta hai.
blocks.caption: Figure 14.6: Selective Catalytic Reduction (kitab ki Figure 14.6 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Pehle oxidation catalyst CO aur hydrocarbons (HC) ko CO₂ aur H₂O mein badalta hai. Phir urea dosing system urea ka spray dalta hai, jo garmi se NH₃ deta hai; SCR catalyst par yeh NH₃ NOₓ ko N₂ aur paani mein badal deti hai. Aakhri NH₃ oxidate catalyst bachi hui NH₃ ko khatam karta hai.
